mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% per annum signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 12-month moving averages signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), a further unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% and rises by >0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) consistently indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 600.0 thousand units per month signal residential construction contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 600.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals monetary tightening during labor market weakness, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month and UNRATE > 8.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises >0.2pp in 1 month and UNRATE >8.0%, or Rank IC for joint signal < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In declining industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 100), a further INDPRO drop exceeding 1.0 point over one month signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and falls >1.0 point in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
